<style type="text/css">

.tocify {
width: 20%;
max-height: 90%;
overflow: auto;
margin-left: 2%;
position: fixed;
border: 1px solid #ccc;
border-radius: 6px;
}

.tocify ul, .tocify li {
list-style: none;
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
border: none;
line-height: 30px;
}

.tocify-header {
text-indent: 10px;
}

.tocify-subheader {
text-indent: 20px;
display: none;
}

.tocify-subheader li {
font-size: 12px;
}

.tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader {
text-indent: 30px;
}
.tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader {
text-indent: 40px;
}
.tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader {
text-indent: 50px;
}
.tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader .tocify-subheader {
text-indent: 60px;
}

.tocify .tocify-item > a, .tocify .nav-list .nav-header {
margin: 0px;
}

.tocify .tocify-item a, .tocify .list-group-item {
padding: 5px;
}
.tocify .nav-pills > li {
float: none;
}


</style>

        // walk up the ancestors of this element, show any hidden tabs
        $selector.parents('.section.tabset').each(function(i, elm) {
          var link = $('a[href="#' + $(elm).attr('id') + '"]');
          if(link.data('toggle') === "tab") {
            link.tab("show");
          }
        });
      }
    };


    // Set the correct tab when the page loads
    showStuffFromHash(context);

    // Set the correct tab when a user uses their back/forward button
    $(window).on('hashchange', function() {
      showStuffFromHash(context);
    });

    // Change the URL when tabs are clicked
    $('a', context).on('click', function(e) {
      history.pushState(null, null, this.href);
      showStuffFromHash(context);
    });

    return this;
  };
}(jQuery));

window.buildTabsets = function(tocID) {

  // build a tabset from a section div with the .tabset class
  function buildTabset(tabset) {

    // check for fade and pills options
    var fade = tabset.hasClass("tabset-fade");
    var pills = tabset.hasClass("tabset-pills");
    var navClass = pills ? "nav-pills" : "nav-tabs";

    // determine the heading level of the tabset and tabs
    var match = tabset.attr('class').match(/level(\d) /);
    if (match === null)
      return;
    var tabsetLevel = Number(match[1]);
    var tabLevel = tabsetLevel + 1;

    // find all subheadings immediately below
    var tabs = tabset.find("div.section.level" + tabLevel);
    if (!tabs.length)
      return;

    // create tablist and tab-content elements
    var tabList = $('<ul class="nav ' + navClass + '" role="tablist"></ul>');
    $(tabs[0]).before(tabList);
    var tabContent = $('<div class="tab-content"></div>');
    $(tabs[0]).before(tabContent);

    // build the tabset
    var activeTab = 0;
    tabs.each(function(i) {

      // get the tab div
      var tab = $(tabs[i]);

      // get the id then sanitize it for use with bootstrap tabs
      var id = tab.attr('id');

      // see if this is marked as the active tab
      if (tab.hasClass('active'))
        activeTab = i;

      // remove any table of contents entries associated with
      // this ID (since we'll be removing the heading element)
      $("div#" + tocID + " li a[href='#" + id + "']").parent().remove();

      // sanitize the id for use with bootstrap tabs
      id = id.replace(/[.\/?&!#<>]/g, '').replace(/\s/g, '_');
      tab.attr('id', id);

      // get the heading element within it, grab it's text, then remove it
      var heading = tab.find('h' + tabLevel + ':first');
      var headingText = heading.html();
      heading.remove();

      // build and append the tab list item
      var a = $('<a role="tab" data-toggle="tab">' + headingText + '</a>');
      a.attr('href', '#' + id);
      a.attr('aria-controls', id);
      var li = $('<li role="presentation"></li>');
      li.append(a);
      tabList.append(li);

      // set it's attributes
      tab.attr('role', 'tabpanel');
      tab.addClass('tab-pane');
      tab.addClass('tabbed-pane');
      if (fade)
        tab.addClass('fade');

      // move it into the tab content div
      tab.detach().appendTo(tabContent);
    });

    // set active tab
    $(tabList.children('li')[activeTab]).addClass('active');
    var active = $(tabContent.children('div.section')[activeTab]);
    active.addClass('active');
    if (fade)
      active.addClass('in');

    if (tabset.hasClass("tabset-sticky"))
      tabset.rmarkdownStickyTabs();
  }

  // convert section divs with the .tabset class to tabsets
  var tabsets = $("div.section.tabset");
  tabsets.each(function(i) {
    buildTabset($(tabsets[i]));
  });
};

</script>
<script>
window.initializeCodeFolding = function(show) {

  // handlers for show-all and hide all
  $("#rmd-show-all-code").click(function() {
    $('div.r-code-collapse').each(function() {
      $(this).collapse('show');
    });
  });
  $("#rmd-hide-all-code").click(function() {
    $('div.r-code-collapse').each(function() {
      $(this).collapse('hide');
    });
  });

  // index for unique code element ids
  var currentIndex = 1;

  // select all R code blocks
  var rCodeBlocks = $('pre.r, pre.python, pre.bash, pre.sql, pre.cpp, pre.stan, pre.julia, pre.foldable');
  rCodeBlocks.each(function() {
    // skip if the block has fold-none class
    if ($(this).hasClass('fold-none')) return;

    // create a collapsable div to wrap the code in
    var div = $('<div class="collapse r-code-collapse"></div>');
    var showThis = (show || $(this).hasClass('fold-show')) && !$(this).hasClass('fold-hide');
    var id = 'rcode-643E0F36' + currentIndex++;
    div.attr('id', id);
    $(this).before(div);
    $(this).detach().appendTo(div);

    // add a show code button right above
    var showCodeText = $('<span>' + (showThis ? 'Hide' : 'Show') + '</span>');
    var showCodeButton = $('<button type="button" class="btn btn-default btn-xs btn-secondary btn-sm code-folding-btn pull-right float-right"></button>');
    showCodeButton.append(showCodeText);
    showCodeButton
        .attr('data-toggle', 'collapse')
        .attr('data-bs-toggle', 'collapse') // BS5
        .attr('data-target', '#' + id)
        .attr('data-bs-target', '#' + id)   // BS5
        .attr('aria-expanded', showThis)
        .attr('aria-controls', id);

    var buttonRow = $('<div class="row"></div>');
    var buttonCol = $('<div class="col-md-12"></div>');

    buttonCol.append(showCodeButton);
    buttonRow.append(buttonCol);

    div.before(buttonRow);

    // show the div if necessary
    if (showThis) div.collapse('show');

    // update state of button on show/hide
    //   * Change text
    //   * add a class for intermediate states styling
    div.on('hide.bs.collapse', function () {
      showCodeText.text('Show');
      showCodeButton.addClass('btn-collapsing');
    });
    div.on('hidden.bs.collapse', function () {
      showCodeButton.removeClass('btn-collapsing');
    });
    div.on('show.bs.collapse', function () {
      showCodeText.text('Hide');
      showCodeButton.addClass('btn-expanding');
    });
    div.on('shown.bs.collapse', function () {
      showCodeButton.removeClass('btn-expanding');
    });

  });

}
</script>

<script>
// apply pandoc div.sourceCode style to pre.sourceCode instead
(function() {
  var sheets = document.styleSheets;
  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].ownerNode.dataset["origin"] !== "pandoc") continue;
    try { var rules = sheets[i].cssRules; } catch (e) { continue; }
    var j = 0;
    while (j < rules.length) {
      var rule = rules[j];
      // check if there is a div.sourceCode rule
      if (rule.type !== rule.STYLE_RULE || rule.selectorText !== "div.sourceCode") {
        j++;
        continue;
      }
      var style = rule.style.cssText;
      // check if color or background-color is set
      if (rule.style.color === '' && rule.style.backgroundColor === '') {
        j++;
        continue;
      }
      // replace div.sourceCode by a pre.sourceCode rule
      sheets[i].deleteRule(j);
      sheets[i].insertRule('pre.sourceCode{' + style + '}', j);
    }
  }
})();
</script>

<h1 class="title toc-ignore">Credit Risk Modelling — Probability of
Default (PD)</h1>
<h4 class="author">Andre Gregory</h4>
<h4 class="date">May 2026</h4>

</div>


<hr />
<div id="overview" class="section level2">
<h2>Overview</h2>
<p>This project builds a <strong>logistic regression Probability of
Default (PD) model</strong> on the German Credit dataset (1,000 loan
applicants). PD models are a core component of the <strong>Basel III
Internal Ratings-Based (IRB)</strong> approach to credit risk capital —
banks using the IRB approach must internally estimate the probability
that each borrower defaults within a 12-month horizon.</p>
<p>The model is evaluated using three metrics required by regulators
(APRA, EBA):</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Metric</th>
<th>Benchmark</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td>AUROC</td>
<td>≥ 0.70</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Gini</td>
<td>≥ 0.30</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>KS Statistic</td>
<td>≥ 0.30</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr />
</div>
<div id="setup-data" class="section level2">
<h2>1. Setup &amp; Data</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb1-1"><a href="#cb1-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(caret)       <span class="co"># GermanCredit dataset + cross-validation</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a href="#cb1-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(pROC)        <span class="co"># ROC curve and AUC</span></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a href="#cb1-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(ggplot2)     <span class="co"># Plots</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a href="#cb1-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(gridExtra)   <span class="co"># Multi-panel layouts</span></span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a href="#cb1-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(dplyr)       <span class="co"># Data wrangling</span></span>
<span id="cb1-6"><a href="#cb1-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb1-7"><a href="#cb1-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">set.seed</span>(<span class="dv">42</span>)</span>
<span id="cb1-8"><a href="#cb1-8" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb1-9"><a href="#cb1-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">data</span>(<span class="st">&quot;GermanCredit&quot;</span>)</span>
<span id="cb1-10"><a href="#cb1-10" tabindex="-1"></a>df <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> GermanCredit</span>
<span id="cb1-11"><a href="#cb1-11" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb1-12"><a href="#cb1-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Binary target: 1 = Default (Bad), 0 = No Default (Good)</span></span>
<span id="cb1-13"><a href="#cb1-13" tabindex="-1"></a>df<span class="sc">$</span>default <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">ifelse</span>(df<span class="sc">$</span>Class <span class="sc">==</span> <span class="st">&quot;Bad&quot;</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">0</span>)</span>
<span id="cb1-14"><a href="#cb1-14" tabindex="-1"></a>df<span class="sc">$</span>Class   <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="cn">NULL</span></span></code></pre></div>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb2-1"><a href="#cb2-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span>(<span class="st">&quot;Rows:&quot;</span>, <span class="fu">nrow</span>(df), <span class="st">&quot;| Cols:&quot;</span>, <span class="fu">ncol</span>(df))</span></code></pre></div>
<pre><code>## Rows: 1000 | Cols: 62</code></pre>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb4-1"><a href="#cb4-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span>(<span class="st">&quot;</span><span class="sc">\n</span><span class="st">Overall default rate:&quot;</span>, <span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(df<span class="sc">$</span>default) <span class="sc">*</span> <span class="dv">100</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>), <span class="st">&quot;%&quot;</span>)</span></code></pre></div>
<pre><code>## 
## Overall default rate: 30 %</code></pre>
<p>The dataset contains <strong>1,000 German loan applicants</strong>
with a <strong>30% default rate</strong> — realistic for a consumer
credit portfolio. Features include loan amount, duration, credit
history, savings, employment length, housing status, and loan
purpose.</p>
<hr />
</div>
<div id="feature-selection-information-value-iv" class="section level2">
<h2>2. Feature Selection — Information Value (IV)</h2>
<p>Information Value measures how well each variable <strong>separates
defaulters from non-defaulters</strong>. It is the standard feature
selection method in retail credit scorecard development.</p>
<p><strong>Rule of thumb:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>IV &lt; 0.02 → useless</li>
<li>0.02–0.10 → weak predictor</li>
<li>0.10–0.30 → medium predictor</li>
<li>&gt; 0.30 → strong predictor</li>
</ul>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb6-1"><a href="#cb6-1" tabindex="-1"></a>compute_iv <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="cf">function</span>(feature, target) {</span>
<span id="cb6-2"><a href="#cb6-2" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">if</span> (<span class="fu">length</span>(<span class="fu">unique</span>(feature)) <span class="sc">&gt;</span> <span class="dv">10</span>) {</span>
<span id="cb6-3"><a href="#cb6-3" tabindex="-1"></a>    bins <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">cut</span>(feature,</span>
<span id="cb6-4"><a href="#cb6-4" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="at">breaks =</span> <span class="fu">quantile</span>(feature, <span class="at">probs =</span> <span class="fu">seq</span>(<span class="dv">0</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="fl">0.25</span>), <span class="at">na.rm =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>),</span>
<span id="cb6-5"><a href="#cb6-5" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="at">include.lowest =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb6-6"><a href="#cb6-6" tabindex="-1"></a>  } <span class="cf">else</span> {</span>
<span id="cb6-7"><a href="#cb6-7" tabindex="-1"></a>    bins <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">as.factor</span>(feature)</span>
<span id="cb6-8"><a href="#cb6-8" tabindex="-1"></a>  }</span>
<span id="cb6-9"><a href="#cb6-9" tabindex="-1"></a>  tbl  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">table</span>(bins, target)</span>
<span id="cb6-10"><a href="#cb6-10" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">if</span> (<span class="fu">ncol</span>(tbl) <span class="sc">&lt;</span> <span class="dv">2</span>) <span class="fu">return</span>(<span class="dv">0</span>)</span>
<span id="cb6-11"><a href="#cb6-11" tabindex="-1"></a>  good <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> tbl[, <span class="dv">1</span>] <span class="sc">/</span> <span class="fu">sum</span>(tbl[, <span class="dv">1</span>]) <span class="sc">+</span> <span class="fl">1e-10</span></span>
<span id="cb6-12"><a href="#cb6-12" tabindex="-1"></a>  bad  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> tbl[, <span class="dv">2</span>] <span class="sc">/</span> <span class="fu">sum</span>(tbl[, <span class="dv">2</span>]) <span class="sc">+</span> <span class="fl">1e-10</span></span>
<span id="cb6-13"><a href="#cb6-13" tabindex="-1"></a>  woe  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">log</span>(good <span class="sc">/</span> bad)</span>
<span id="cb6-14"><a href="#cb6-14" tabindex="-1"></a>  iv   <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sum</span>((good <span class="sc">-</span> bad) <span class="sc">*</span> woe)</span>
<span id="cb6-15"><a href="#cb6-15" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">return</span>(iv)</span>
<span id="cb6-16"><a href="#cb6-16" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span>
<span id="cb6-17"><a href="#cb6-17" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb6-18"><a href="#cb6-18" tabindex="-1"></a>predictors <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">setdiff</span>(<span class="fu">names</span>(df), <span class="st">&quot;default&quot;</span>)</span>
<span id="cb6-19"><a href="#cb6-19" tabindex="-1"></a>iv_scores  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sapply</span>(predictors, <span class="cf">function</span>(v) <span class="fu">compute_iv</span>(df[[v]], df<span class="sc">$</span>default))</span>
<span id="cb6-20"><a href="#cb6-20" tabindex="-1"></a>iv_df      <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">data.frame</span>(<span class="at">variable =</span> <span class="fu">names</span>(iv_scores), <span class="at">IV =</span> iv_scores) <span class="sc">%&gt;%</span></span>
<span id="cb6-21"><a href="#cb6-21" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">arrange</span>(<span class="fu">desc</span>(IV))</span></code></pre></div>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb7-1"><a href="#cb7-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">head</span>(iv_df, <span class="dv">15</span>) <span class="sc">%&gt;%</span></span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a href="#cb7-2" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">ggplot</span>(<span class="fu">aes</span>(<span class="at">x =</span> <span class="fu">reorder</span>(variable, IV), <span class="at">y =</span> IV)) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a href="#cb7-3" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_col</span>(<span class="at">fill =</span> <span class="st">&quot;#1F4E79&quot;</span>, <span class="at">alpha =</span> <span class="fl">0.85</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a href="#cb7-4" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_hline</span>(<span class="at">yintercept =</span> <span class="fl">0.10</span>, <span class="at">linetype =</span> <span class="st">&quot;dashed&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a href="#cb7-5" tabindex="-1"></a>             <span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="st">&quot;#E53935&quot;</span>, <span class="at">linewidth =</span> <span class="fl">0.8</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb7-6"><a href="#cb7-6" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">annotate</span>(<span class="st">&quot;text&quot;</span>, <span class="at">x =</span> <span class="fl">2.5</span>, <span class="at">y =</span> <span class="fl">0.105</span>,</span>
<span id="cb7-7"><a href="#cb7-7" tabindex="-1"></a>           <span class="at">label =</span> <span class="st">&quot;IV = 0.10 (medium threshold)&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb7-8"><a href="#cb7-8" tabindex="-1"></a>           <span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="st">&quot;#E53935&quot;</span>, <span class="at">size =</span> <span class="fl">3.5</span>, <span class="at">hjust =</span> <span class="dv">0</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb7-9"><a href="#cb7-9" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">coord_flip</span>() <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb7-10"><a href="#cb7-10" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">labs</span>(</span>
<span id="cb7-11"><a href="#cb7-11" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">title    =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Feature Importance — Information Value (Top 15)&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb7-12"><a href="#cb7-12" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">subtitle =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Checking account status and credit history are the strongest predictors&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb7-13"><a href="#cb7-13" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">x =</span> <span class="cn">NULL</span>, <span class="at">y =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Information Value (IV)&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb7-14"><a href="#cb7-14" tabindex="-1"></a>  ) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb7-15"><a href="#cb7-15" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">theme_minimal</span>(<span class="at">base_size =</span> <span class="dv">12</span>)</span></code></pre></div>
<p><img src="data:image/png;base64," width="768" style="display: block; margin: auto;" /></p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb8"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb8-1"><a href="#cb8-1" tabindex="-1"></a>selected_vars <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> iv_df <span class="sc">%&gt;%</span> <span class="fu">filter</span>(IV <span class="sc">&gt;=</span> <span class="fl">0.02</span>) <span class="sc">%&gt;%</span> <span class="fu">pull</span>(variable)</span>
<span id="cb8-2"><a href="#cb8-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span>(<span class="st">&quot;Variables retained (IV ≥ 0.02):&quot;</span>, <span class="fu">length</span>(selected_vars), <span class="st">&quot;of&quot;</span>, <span class="fu">length</span>(predictors))</span></code></pre></div>
<pre><code>## Variables retained (IV &lt;U+2265&gt; 0.02): 30 of 61</code></pre>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb10"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb10-1"><a href="#cb10-1" tabindex="-1"></a>model_df <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> df[, <span class="fu">c</span>(selected_vars, <span class="st">&quot;default&quot;</span>)]</span></code></pre></div>
<hr />
</div>
<div id="train-test-split" class="section level2">
<h2>3. Train / Test Split</h2>
<p>A <strong>stratified 70/30 split</strong> preserves the portfolio
default rate in both training and test sets — critical when defaults are
a minority class.</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb11"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb11-1"><a href="#cb11-1" tabindex="-1"></a>train_idx <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">createDataPartition</span>(model_df<span class="sc">$</span>default, <span class="at">p =</span> <span class="fl">0.70</span>, <span class="at">list =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb11-2"><a href="#cb11-2" tabindex="-1"></a>train     <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> model_df[train_idx, ]</span>
<span id="cb11-3"><a href="#cb11-3" tabindex="-1"></a>test      <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> model_df[<span class="sc">-</span>train_idx, ]</span>
<span id="cb11-4"><a href="#cb11-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb11-5"><a href="#cb11-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">data.frame</span>(</span>
<span id="cb11-6"><a href="#cb11-6" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Set          =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;Train&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;Test&quot;</span>),</span>
<span id="cb11-7"><a href="#cb11-7" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">N            =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="fu">nrow</span>(train), <span class="fu">nrow</span>(test)),</span>
<span id="cb11-8"><a href="#cb11-8" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Default_Rate =</span> <span class="fu">paste0</span>(<span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(train<span class="sc">$</span>default)<span class="sc">*</span><span class="dv">100</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>),</span>
<span id="cb11-9"><a href="#cb11-9" tabindex="-1"></a>                          <span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>default)<span class="sc">*</span><span class="dv">100</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>)), <span class="st">&quot;%&quot;</span>)</span>
<span id="cb11-10"><a href="#cb11-10" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span></code></pre></div>
<div class="kable-table">
<table>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th align="left">Set</th>
<th align="right">N</th>
<th align="left">Default_Rate</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td align="left">Train</td>
<td align="right">700</td>
<td align="left">30.1%</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td align="left">Test</td>
<td align="right">300</td>
<td align="left">29.7%</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<hr />
</div>
<div id="model-logistic-regression" class="section level2">
<h2>4. Model — Logistic Regression</h2>
<p>We use logistic regression because:</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal">
<li><strong>Interpretable coefficients</strong> — required under Basel
IRB and IFRS 9 (black-box models face higher regulatory scrutiny)</li>
<li><strong>Direct probability output</strong> — P(default) ∈ (0, 1) for
each borrower</li>
<li><strong>Auditable</strong> — regulators can inspect and challenge
each coefficient</li>
</ol>
<p>The model estimates the log-odds of default:</p>
<p><span class="math display">\[\log\left(\frac{p}{1-p}\right) = \beta_0
+ \beta_1 X_1 + \cdots + \beta_n X_n\]</span></p>
<p>Solving for <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span>:</p>
<p><span class="math display">\[p = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-(\beta_0 + \beta_1
X_1 + \cdots + \beta_n X_n)}}\]</span></p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb12"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb12-1"><a href="#cb12-1" tabindex="-1"></a>formula_str <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">paste</span>(<span class="st">&quot;default ~&quot;</span>, <span class="fu">paste</span>(selected_vars, <span class="at">collapse =</span> <span class="st">&quot; + &quot;</span>))</span>
<span id="cb12-2"><a href="#cb12-2" tabindex="-1"></a>model       <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">glm</span>(<span class="fu">as.formula</span>(formula_str), <span class="at">data =</span> train,</span>
<span id="cb12-3"><a href="#cb12-3" tabindex="-1"></a>                   <span class="at">family =</span> <span class="fu">binomial</span>(<span class="at">link =</span> <span class="st">&quot;logit&quot;</span>))</span>
<span id="cb12-4"><a href="#cb12-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-5"><a href="#cb12-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Show only statistically significant coefficients (p &lt; 0.05)</span></span>
<span id="cb12-6"><a href="#cb12-6" tabindex="-1"></a>coef_df <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">as.data.frame</span>(<span class="fu">summary</span>(model)<span class="sc">$</span>coefficients)</span>
<span id="cb12-7"><a href="#cb12-7" tabindex="-1"></a>coef_df <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> coef_df[coef_df[, <span class="dv">4</span>] <span class="sc">&lt;</span> <span class="fl">0.05</span>, ]</span>
<span id="cb12-8"><a href="#cb12-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">colnames</span>(coef_df) <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;Estimate&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;Std.Error&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;z.value&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;p.value&quot;</span>)</span>
<span id="cb12-9"><a href="#cb12-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">round</span>(coef_df, <span class="dv">4</span>)</span></code></pre></div>
<div class="kable-table">
<table>

<tr class="header">
<th align="left"></th>
<th align="right">Estimate</th>
<th align="right">Std.Error</th>
<th align="right">z.value</th>
<th align="right">p.value</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>

<tr class="even">

</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td align="left">Amount</td>
<td align="right">0.0001</td>
<td align="right">0.0001</td>

</tr>
<tr class="even">

<tr class="odd">

<tr class="even">

<td align="right">0.0027</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p><strong>Key findings from significant coefficients:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code>CheckingAccountStatus.none</code> (−1.23): Having <em>no</em>
checking account is a strong <strong>negative risk signal</strong> —
counterintuitively, borrowers with no account at all are less likely to
default than those with overdrafts</li>
<li><code>CreditHistory.Critical</code> (−0.72): Borrowers with critical
credit history actually default <em>less</em> — they have survived prior
stress and are likely more financially cautious</li>
<li><code>Duration</code> (+0.03): Longer loan terms modestly
<strong>increase</strong> default risk</li>
<li><code>InstallmentRatePercentage</code> (+0.31): Higher repayment
burden as a share of income <strong>increases</strong> risk — captures
affordability stress</li>
<li><code>SavingsAccountBonds.gt.1000</code> (−2.09): Large savings
buffer is the <strong>strongest protective factor</strong></li>
<li><code>Age</code> (−0.03): Older borrowers default less — consistent
with lifecycle income stability</li>
</ul>
<hr />
</div>
<div id="scoring" class="section level2">
<h2>5. Scoring</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb13"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb13-1"><a href="#cb13-1" tabindex="-1"></a>test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score     <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">predict</span>(model, <span class="at">newdata =</span> test, <span class="at">type =</span> <span class="st">&quot;response&quot;</span>)</span>
<span id="cb13-2"><a href="#cb13-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Credit score: higher = safer (FICO-style convention, range ~600–800)</span></span>
<span id="cb13-3"><a href="#cb13-3" tabindex="-1"></a>test<span class="sc">$</span>credit_score <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="dv">600</span> <span class="sc">+</span> (<span class="dv">1</span> <span class="sc">-</span> test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score) <span class="sc">*</span> <span class="dv">200</span>)</span>
<span id="cb13-4"><a href="#cb13-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-5"><a href="#cb13-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">data.frame</span>(</span>
<span id="cb13-6"><a href="#cb13-6" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Metric       =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;Mean PD&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;Mean Credit Score&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;Score Min&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;Score Max&quot;</span>),</span>
<span id="cb13-7"><a href="#cb13-7" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Value        =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score), <span class="dv">4</span>),</span>
<span id="cb13-8"><a href="#cb13-8" tabindex="-1"></a>                   <span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>credit_score)),</span>
<span id="cb13-9"><a href="#cb13-9" tabindex="-1"></a>                   <span class="fu">min</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>credit_score),</span>
<span id="cb13-10"><a href="#cb13-10" tabindex="-1"></a>                   <span class="fu">max</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>credit_score))</span>
<span id="cb13-11"><a href="#cb13-11" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span></code></pre></div>

<div id="model-validation" class="section level2">
<h2>6. Model Validation</h2>
<div id="roc-curve-auroc" class="section level3">
<h3>6.1 ROC Curve &amp; AUROC</h3>
<p>The ROC curve plots <strong>True Positive Rate vs. False Positive
Rate</strong> at every classification threshold. AUROC is the area
beneath it.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>0.50</strong> = no better than random guessing</li>
<li><strong>0.70</strong> = minimum acceptable (Basel guidance)</li>
<li><strong>0.75–0.80</strong> = good</li>
<li><strong>&gt; 0.80</strong> = strong</li>
</ul>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb14"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb14-1"><a href="#cb14-1" tabindex="-1"></a>roc_obj <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">roc</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>default, test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score, <span class="at">quiet =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb14-2"><a href="#cb14-2" tabindex="-1"></a>auroc   <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">as.numeric</span>(<span class="fu">auc</span>(roc_obj))</span>
<span id="cb14-3"><a href="#cb14-3" tabindex="-1"></a>gini    <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="dv">2</span> <span class="sc">*</span> auroc <span class="sc">-</span> <span class="dv">1</span></span>
<span id="cb14-4"><a href="#cb14-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span>(<span class="fu">sprintf</span>(<span class="st">&quot;AUROC: %.4f</span><span class="sc">\n</span><span class="st">Gini:  %.4f&quot;</span>, auroc, gini))</span></code></pre></div>
<pre><code>## AUROC: 0.7782
## Gini:  0.5564</code></pre>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb16"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb16-1"><a href="#cb16-1" tabindex="-1"></a>roc_data <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">data.frame</span>(</span>
<span id="cb16-2"><a href="#cb16-2" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">fpr =</span> <span class="dv">1</span> <span class="sc">-</span> roc_obj<span class="sc">$</span>specificities,</span>
<span id="cb16-3"><a href="#cb16-3" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">tpr =</span> roc_obj<span class="sc">$</span>sensitivities</span>
<span id="cb16-4"><a href="#cb16-4" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb16-5"><a href="#cb16-5" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb16-6"><a href="#cb16-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">ggplot</span>(roc_data, <span class="fu">aes</span>(<span class="at">x =</span> fpr, <span class="at">y =</span> tpr)) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb16-7"><a href="#cb16-7" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_line</span>(<span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="st">&quot;#1F4E79&quot;</span>, <span class="at">linewidth =</span> <span class="fl">1.2</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb16-8"><a href="#cb16-8" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_abline</span>(<span class="at">linetype =</span> <span class="st">&quot;dashed&quot;</span>, <span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="st">&quot;grey60&quot;</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb16-9"><a href="#cb16-9" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_area</span>(<span class="at">alpha =</span> <span class="fl">0.08</span>, <span class="at">fill =</span> <span class="st">&quot;#1F4E79&quot;</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb16-10"><a href="#cb16-10" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">annotate</span>(<span class="st">&quot;label&quot;</span>, <span class="at">x =</span> <span class="fl">0.62</span>, <span class="at">y =</span> <span class="fl">0.18</span>,</span>
<span id="cb16-11"><a href="#cb16-11" tabindex="-1"></a>           <span class="at">label =</span> <span class="fu">sprintf</span>(<span class="st">&quot;AUROC = %.3f</span><span class="sc">\n</span><span class="st">Gini   = %.3f&quot;</span>, auroc, gini),</span>
<span id="cb16-12"><a href="#cb16-12" tabindex="-1"></a>           <span class="at">size =</span> <span class="dv">4</span>, <span class="at">hjust =</span> <span class="dv">0</span>, <span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="st">&quot;#1F4E79&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb16-13"><a href="#cb16-13" tabindex="-1"></a>           <span class="at">fill =</span> <span class="st">&quot;white&quot;</span>, <span class="at">label.size =</span> <span class="fl">0.3</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb16-14"><a href="#cb16-14" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">labs</span>(</span>
<span id="cb16-15"><a href="#cb16-15" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">title    =</span> <span class="st">&quot;ROC Curve — Logistic Regression PD Model&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb16-16"><a href="#cb16-16" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">subtitle =</span> <span class="fu">sprintf</span>(<span class="st">&quot;Test set (n = %d) | AUROC = %.3f exceeds Basel benchmark of 0.70&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb16-17"><a href="#cb16-17" tabindex="-1"></a>                       <span class="fu">nrow</span>(test), auroc),</span>
<span id="cb16-18"><a href="#cb16-18" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">x =</span> <span class="st">&quot;False Positive Rate (1 − Specificity)&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb16-19"><a href="#cb16-19" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">y =</span> <span class="st">&quot;True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb16-20"><a href="#cb16-20" tabindex="-1"></a>  ) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb16-21"><a href="#cb16-21" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">theme_minimal</span>(<span class="at">base_size =</span> <span class="dv">12</span>)</span></code></pre></div>
<p><img src="data:image/png;base64," width="768" style="display: block; margin: auto;" /></p>
</div>
<div id="score-distribution-by-outcome" class="section level3">
<h3>6.2 Score Distribution by Outcome</h3>
<p>A well-discriminating model should show <strong>clear
separation</strong> between the PD distributions of defaulters and
non-defaulters. The KS statistic measures the maximum gap between their
CDFs.</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb17"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb17-1"><a href="#cb17-1" tabindex="-1"></a>scores_bad <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score[test<span class="sc">$</span>default <span class="sc">==</span> <span class="dv">1</span>]</span>
<span id="cb17-2"><a href="#cb17-2" tabindex="-1"></a>scores_good <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score[test<span class="sc">$</span>default <span class="sc">==</span> <span class="dv">0</span>]</span>
<span id="cb17-3"><a href="#cb17-3" tabindex="-1"></a>ks_stat <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">max</span>(<span class="fu">abs</span>(<span class="fu">ecdf</span>(scores_bad)(<span class="fu">sort</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score)) <span class="sc">-</span></span>
<span id="cb17-4"><a href="#cb17-4" tabindex="-1"></a>                     <span class="fu">ecdf</span>(scores_good)(<span class="fu">sort</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score))))</span>
<span id="cb17-5"><a href="#cb17-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cat</span>(<span class="fu">sprintf</span>(<span class="st">&quot;KS Statistic: %.4f  (benchmark ≥ 0.30)&quot;</span>, ks_stat))</span></code></pre></div>
<pre><code>## KS Statistic: 0.4477  (benchmark &lt;U+2265&gt; 0.30)</code></pre>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb19"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb19-1"><a href="#cb19-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">ggplot</span>(test, <span class="fu">aes</span>(<span class="at">x =</span> pd_score, <span class="at">fill =</span> <span class="fu">as.factor</span>(default))) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb19-2"><a href="#cb19-2" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_density</span>(<span class="at">alpha =</span> <span class="fl">0.55</span>, <span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="cn">NA</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb19-3"><a href="#cb19-3" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">scale_fill_manual</span>(</span>
<span id="cb19-4"><a href="#cb19-4" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">values =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;0&quot;</span> <span class="ot">=</span> <span class="st">&quot;#2196F3&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;1&quot;</span> <span class="ot">=</span> <span class="st">&quot;#E53935&quot;</span>),</span>
<span id="cb19-5"><a href="#cb19-5" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">labels =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;No Default&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;Default&quot;</span>),</span>
<span id="cb19-6"><a href="#cb19-6" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">name   =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Outcome&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb19-7"><a href="#cb19-7" tabindex="-1"></a>  ) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb19-8"><a href="#cb19-8" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_vline</span>(<span class="at">xintercept =</span> <span class="fl">0.5</span>, <span class="at">linetype =</span> <span class="st">&quot;dashed&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb19-9"><a href="#cb19-9" tabindex="-1"></a>             <span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="st">&quot;grey40&quot;</span>, <span class="at">linewidth =</span> <span class="fl">0.7</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb19-10"><a href="#cb19-10" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">annotate</span>(<span class="st">&quot;text&quot;</span>, <span class="at">x =</span> <span class="fl">0.52</span>, <span class="at">y =</span> <span class="fl">3.2</span>, <span class="at">label =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Threshold = 0.50&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb19-11"><a href="#cb19-11" tabindex="-1"></a>           <span class="at">hjust =</span> <span class="dv">0</span>, <span class="at">size =</span> <span class="fl">3.5</span>, <span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="st">&quot;grey30&quot;</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb19-12"><a href="#cb19-12" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">labs</span>(</span>
<span id="cb19-13"><a href="#cb19-13" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">title    =</span> <span class="st">&quot;PD Score Distribution by Outcome&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb19-14"><a href="#cb19-14" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">subtitle =</span> <span class="fu">sprintf</span>(<span class="st">&quot;KS Statistic = %.3f | Clear separation between defaulters and non-defaulters&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb19-15"><a href="#cb19-15" tabindex="-1"></a>                       ks_stat),</span>
<span id="cb19-16"><a href="#cb19-16" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">x =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Predicted Probability of Default (PD)&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb19-17"><a href="#cb19-17" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">y =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Density&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb19-18"><a href="#cb19-18" tabindex="-1"></a>  ) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb19-19"><a href="#cb19-19" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">theme_minimal</span>(<span class="at">base_size =</span> <span class="dv">12</span>)</span></code></pre></div>
<p><img src="data:image/png;base64," width="768" style="display: block; margin: auto;" /></p>
</div>
<div id="performance-summary" class="section level3">
<h3>6.3 Performance Summary</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb20"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb20-1"><a href="#cb20-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">data.frame</span>(</span>
<span id="cb20-2"><a href="#cb20-2" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Metric    =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;AUROC&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;Gini Coefficient&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;KS Statistic&quot;</span>),</span>
<span id="cb20-3"><a href="#cb20-3" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Value     =</span> <span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">c</span>(auroc, gini, ks_stat), <span class="dv">4</span>),</span>
<span id="cb20-4"><a href="#cb20-4" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Benchmark =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;≥ 0.70&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;≥ 0.30&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;≥ 0.30&quot;</span>),</span>
<span id="cb20-5"><a href="#cb20-5" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Result    =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;✓ Pass&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;✓ Pass&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;✓ Pass&quot;</span>)</span>
<span id="cb20-6"><a href="#cb20-6" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span></code></pre></div>

<div id="confusion-matrix" class="section level3">
<h3>6.4 Confusion Matrix</h3>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb21"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb21-1"><a href="#cb21-1" tabindex="-1"></a>test<span class="sc">$</span>predicted_class <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">ifelse</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score <span class="sc">&gt;=</span> <span class="fl">0.5</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">0</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-2"><a href="#cb21-2" tabindex="-1"></a>cm <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">confusionMatrix</span>(<span class="fu">as.factor</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>predicted_class),</span>
<span id="cb21-3"><a href="#cb21-3" tabindex="-1"></a>                      <span class="fu">as.factor</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>default), <span class="at">positive =</span> <span class="st">&quot;1&quot;</span>)</span>
<span id="cb21-4"><a href="#cb21-4" tabindex="-1"></a>cm<span class="sc">$</span>table</span></code></pre></div>
<pre><code>##           Reference
## Prediction   0   1
##          0 182  39
##          1  29  50</code></pre>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb23"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb23-1"><a href="#cb23-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">data.frame</span>(</span>
<span id="cb23-2"><a href="#cb23-2" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Metric      =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;Accuracy&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;Sensitivity&quot;</span>, <span class="st">&quot;Specificity&quot;</span>),</span>
<span id="cb23-3"><a href="#cb23-3" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Value       =</span> <span class="fu">paste0</span>(<span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">c</span>(cm<span class="sc">$</span>overall[<span class="st">&quot;Accuracy&quot;</span>],</span>
<span id="cb23-4"><a href="#cb23-4" tabindex="-1"></a>                               cm<span class="sc">$</span>byClass[<span class="st">&quot;Sensitivity&quot;</span>],</span>
<span id="cb23-5"><a href="#cb23-5" tabindex="-1"></a>                               cm<span class="sc">$</span>byClass[<span class="st">&quot;Specificity&quot;</span>]) <span class="sc">*</span> <span class="dv">100</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>), <span class="st">&quot;%&quot;</span>),</span>
<span id="cb23-6"><a href="#cb23-6" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">Description =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">&quot;Overall correct classifications&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb23-7"><a href="#cb23-7" tabindex="-1"></a>                  <span class="st">&quot;Defaulters correctly identified&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb23-8"><a href="#cb23-8" tabindex="-1"></a>                  <span class="st">&quot;Non-defaulters correctly identified&quot;</span>)</span>
<span id="cb23-9"><a href="#cb23-9" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span></code></pre></div>

<div id="decile-analysis" class="section level2">
<h2>7. Decile Analysis</h2>
<p>In credit risk practice, models are validated by ranking borrowers
into <strong>10 equal groups by predicted PD</strong> (deciles) and
checking that actual default rates decline monotonically from decile 1
(riskiest) to decile 10 (safest). This is standard reporting in IRB
model validation under APRA APS 113.</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb24"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb24-1"><a href="#cb24-1" tabindex="-1"></a>test<span class="sc">$</span>decile <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">ntile</span>(<span class="fu">desc</span>(test<span class="sc">$</span>pd_score), <span class="dv">10</span>)</span>
<span id="cb24-2"><a href="#cb24-2" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-3"><a href="#cb24-3" tabindex="-1"></a>decile_tbl <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> test <span class="sc">%&gt;%</span></span>
<span id="cb24-4"><a href="#cb24-4" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">group_by</span>(<span class="at">Decile =</span> decile) <span class="sc">%&gt;%</span></span>
<span id="cb24-5"><a href="#cb24-5" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">summarise</span>(</span>
<span id="cb24-6"><a href="#cb24-6" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">N           =</span> <span class="fu">n</span>(),</span>
<span id="cb24-7"><a href="#cb24-7" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">Defaults    =</span> <span class="fu">sum</span>(default),</span>
<span id="cb24-8"><a href="#cb24-8" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">Default_Rate =</span> <span class="fu">paste0</span>(<span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(default) <span class="sc">*</span> <span class="dv">100</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>), <span class="st">&quot;%&quot;</span>),</span>
<span id="cb24-9"><a href="#cb24-9" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">Avg_PD      =</span> <span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(pd_score), <span class="dv">3</span>),</span>
<span id="cb24-10"><a href="#cb24-10" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">Avg_Score   =</span> <span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(credit_score))</span>
<span id="cb24-11"><a href="#cb24-11" tabindex="-1"></a>  )</span>
<span id="cb24-12"><a href="#cb24-12" tabindex="-1"></a>decile_tbl</span></code></pre></div>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb25"><pre class="sourceCode r"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb25-1"><a href="#cb25-1" tabindex="-1"></a>decile_num <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> test <span class="sc">%&gt;%</span></span>
<span id="cb25-2"><a href="#cb25-2" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">group_by</span>(decile) <span class="sc">%&gt;%</span></span>
<span id="cb25-3"><a href="#cb25-3" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">summarise</span>(<span class="at">default_rate =</span> <span class="fu">mean</span>(default) <span class="sc">*</span> <span class="dv">100</span>)</span>
<span id="cb25-4"><a href="#cb25-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb25-5"><a href="#cb25-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">ggplot</span>(decile_num, <span class="fu">aes</span>(<span class="at">x =</span> decile, <span class="at">y =</span> default_rate)) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb25-6"><a href="#cb25-6" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_col</span>(<span class="at">fill =</span> <span class="st">&quot;#1F4E79&quot;</span>, <span class="at">alpha =</span> <span class="fl">0.85</span>, <span class="at">width =</span> <span class="fl">0.7</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb25-7"><a href="#cb25-7" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_line</span>(<span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="st">&quot;#E53935&quot;</span>, <span class="at">linewidth =</span> <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="at">linetype =</span> <span class="st">&quot;dashed&quot;</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb25-8"><a href="#cb25-8" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_point</span>(<span class="at">colour =</span> <span class="st">&quot;#E53935&quot;</span>, <span class="at">size =</span> <span class="fl">2.5</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb25-9"><a href="#cb25-9" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">geom_text</span>(<span class="fu">aes</span>(<span class="at">label =</span> <span class="fu">paste0</span>(<span class="fu">round</span>(default_rate, <span class="dv">1</span>), <span class="st">&quot;%&quot;</span>)),</span>
<span id="cb25-10"><a href="#cb25-10" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="at">vjust =</span> <span class="sc">-</span><span class="fl">0.6</span>, <span class="at">size =</span> <span class="fl">3.5</span>, <span class="at">fontface =</span> <span class="st">&quot;bold&quot;</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb25-11"><a href="#cb25-11" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">scale_x_continuous</span>(<span class="at">breaks =</span> <span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">:</span><span class="dv">10</span>) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb25-12"><a href="#cb25-12" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">labs</span>(</span>
<span id="cb25-13"><a href="#cb25-13" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">title    =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Default Rate by Score Decile&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb25-14"><a href="#cb25-14" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">subtitle =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Decile 1 = highest predicted risk | Monotonic decline confirms good model ordering&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb25-15"><a href="#cb25-15" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">x =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Decile (1 = Highest PD, 10 = Lowest PD)&quot;</span>,</span>
<span id="cb25-16"><a href="#cb25-16" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="at">y =</span> <span class="st">&quot;Actual Default Rate (%)&quot;</span></span>
<span id="cb25-17"><a href="#cb25-17" tabindex="-1"></a>  ) <span class="sc">+</span></span>
<span id="cb25-18"><a href="#cb25-18" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="fu">theme_minimal</span>(<span class="at">base_size =</span> <span class="dv">12</span>)</span></code></pre></div>
<p><img src="data:image/png;base64," width="768" style="display: block; margin: auto;" /></p>
<p>Default rates range from <strong>70%</strong> in decile 1 to
<strong>6.7%</strong> in decile 10 — clean monotonic ordering confirming
the model correctly ranks risk across the portfolio.</p>
<hr />
</div>
<div id="regulatory-context" class="section level2">
<h2>8. Regulatory Context</h2>
<p>This model replicates the core components of a <strong>Basel III IRB
PD model</strong>:</p>
<table>
<colgroup>
<col width="22%" />
<col width="26%" />
<col width="52%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Component</th>
<th>This Project</th>
<th>Basel III / APRA APS 113</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Model type</td>
<td>Logistic regression</td>
<td>Must be interpretable and auditable</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Performance metric</td>
<td>AUROC, Gini</td>
<td>Minimum discriminatory power required</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Validation method</td>
<td>KS statistic, decile analysis</td>
<td>Standard IRB model validation</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Output</td>
<td>PD estimate per borrower</td>
<td>Required for RWA capital calculation</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Under <strong>IFRS 9</strong> (effective 2018, adopted in Australia),
banks must estimate 12-month and lifetime PD for expected credit loss
provisioning. This project models the first stage of that process.</p>
<hr />
<p><em>Dataset: <a href="https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/statlog+(german+credit+data)">German
Credit (UCI)</a> via <code>caret::GermanCredit</code></em><br />
<em>Packages: <code>caret</code>, <code>pROC</code>,
<code>ggplot2</code>, <code>dplyr</code>,
<code>gridExtra</code></em></p>
</div>
